## Homework

**swirl tutorials** — interactive R lessons that run inside R itself:

```r
install.packages("swirl")
library(swirl)
swirl()
```

When prompted, choose the **R Programming** course and complete these lessons:

1. Basic Building Blocks
2. Workspace and Files
3. Sequences of Numbers
4. Vectors
5. Missing Values
6. Subsetting Vectors
7. Matrices and Data Frames
8. Logic
12. Looking at Data
15. Base Graphics

Save the R script you work in as you go (one script per lesson is fine). Submit your R script files via Canvas **before noon Tuesday** ahead of Session 2.

Also read Stanton **Ch. 1** before next class *(and if you couldn't finish the Intro and Appendices A–C before the first class, complete them this week)*.
